name: memory-query
description: Semantic search over the knowledge graph for the nodes most similar to the query. Use it to find everything known about a topic without a target entity, e.g. 'investor relations'. Optionally filter by node type or sensitivity ceiling. A fact belongs to the entities in its owners, not to whoever the query names; unattached: true means it has none.

inputs.query: string (natural language search string, e.g. 'investor relations' or 'Q3 board meeting')
inputs.type: string? (optional node type filter — one of: person, organization, project, decision, event, concept, fact)
inputs.limit: number? (max results to return; defaults to 10, capped at 50)
inputs.max_sensitivity: string? (optional sensitivity ceiling — one of: public, internal, confidential, restricted. When provided, only nodes at or below this level are returned. Omit to return nodes of any sensitivity.)

outputs.results: array of {id, type, label, properties, confidence, decay_class, sensitivity, last_confirmed_at, score}; fact results add owners [{id, type, label}] (at most 5), unattached: true when it has no owner, more_owners (count past 5) and owners_withheld (count above max_sensitivity)
